<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr) where a halide on an aromatic ring is replaced by an amine. The functional groups broken in the forward reaction are “halide” and the functional groups formed are “primary amines” (or secondary/tertiary depending on the nucleophile). Using the available functional‑group list, we can search the template catalog for templates that break a halide and form a primary amine. This should return the appropriate template ID and its SMARTS, from which we can construct the mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)Cl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
